statement: Lam Research Corporation's revenue increased 8% in the September 2024 quarter compared to the June 2024 quarter.

The revenue increase was driven by increases in systems revenue due to strengthened investments in the dynamic random access memory ('DRAM') market segment and increases in customer support-related revenue.
Lennox International Inc.'s Home Comfort Solutions segment net sales increased 7% in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.
Lennox International Inc.'s Home Comfort Solutions segment profit increased $5 million in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.
Walmart Inc.'s total revenues increased $9.2 billion or 6.0% for the three months ended April 30, 2024, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.

The revenue increase was primarily driven by strong positive comparable sales in U.S. segments and international markets, including growth in transactions, strong sales in grocery, and strength in eCommerce.
International markets contributed to the revenue growth with constant currency sales growth of 10.7%, reflecting strength in Walmex, China, and Flipkart.
Northrop Grumman Corporation's total lease cost was $470 million for the year ended December 31, 2024.
The total lease cost for Northrop Grumman Corporation increased from $475 million in 2023 to $470 million in 2024.
Operating lease cost for Northrop Grumman Corporation was $370 million in 2024.
Northrop Grumman Corporation had $120 million of unrecognized compensation expense related to cash awards at December 31, 2024.
Yum! Brands, Inc. terminated its franchise agreements with IS Gida A.S. in Turkey, affecting 284 KFC and 254 Pizza Hut restaurants, which will reduce unit counts by the end of Q1 2025.
The termination of franchise agreements in Turkey resulted in a $61 million charge in FY2024, primarily from transaction costs and termination-related expenses.
The loss of royalties from closed Turkey restaurants will not materially impact Core Operating Profit in 2025 or beyond.
Essex Property Trust, Inc. uses financial occupancy as a meaningful measure of occupancy because it considers the value of each vacant unit at its estimated market rate.
The Company calculates financial occupancy using recently signed effective rates on new leases as the starting point for determining market rates of vacant apartment homes.
Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. identified quality issues involving noncompliance with welding procedures at Newport News during the third quarter of FY2024.
The Company is investigating quality issues at Newport News in collaboration with its U.S. Navy customer to assess potential operational impacts.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s architectural coatings - Americas and Asia Pacific organic sales increased a low single-digit percentage compared to the prior-year third quarter.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s architectural coatings - EMEA organic sales were flat year over year.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s automotive refinish coatings organic sales increased by a mid-single-digit percentage versus the prior year.
PPG Industries, Inc.'s protective and marine coatings organic sales increased by a low single-digit percentage compared to the prior-year third quarter.
Realty Income Corporation invested $1.4 billion in real estate acquisitions during the three months ended March 31, 2025, at a 7.5% weighted average initial cash yield.
The acquisitions included 50 properties across U.S. and Europe real estate, totaling 3,727 leasable square feet and $1,026.3 million in investment.
News Corporation's Move segment revenues decreased $55 million, or 12%, to $401 million for the nine months ended March 31, 2024, compared to $456 million in the corresponding period of fiscal 2023.

The decrease in Move segment revenues was driven by the continued impact of the macroeconomic environment on the U.S. housing market, including higher interest rates, which resulted in lower lead volumes (down 5%) and lower transaction volumes.
Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated's net CF product revenues increased to $2.6 billion in the second quarter of 2024 compared to $2.5 billion in the second quarter of 2023.

The revenue increase was primarily due to the performance of TRIKAFTA in the U.S., including its launch in children with CF 2 to 5 years of age and continued strong uptake in ex-U.S. markets and label extensions in younger age groups.
3M Company's stock-based compensation expense is typically recognized in the first quarter due to retiree-eligible employees representing 31% of the annual grant.
Abbott Laboratories' Diagnostic Products segment includes Core Laboratory Diagnostics, Rapid Diagnostics, Molecular Diagnostics, and Point of Care Diagnostics businesses.
Abbott Laboratories' Medical Devices segment includes Cardiac Rhythm Management, Electrophysiology, Heart Failure, Vascular, Structural Heart, Neuromodulation, and Diabetes Care businesses.
Sysco Corporation's Foodservice Operations increased 2.9% in the third quarter of fiscal 2024 compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2023.
The increase in Foodservice Operations was primarily driven by acquisitions in the third quarter of fiscal 2024.
Foodservice Operations' growth included a 1.3% increase in case volume in the first 39 weeks of fiscal 2024.
Valero Energy Corp's Ethanol segment reported $105 million of operating income for the second quarter of 2024.
The Ethanol segment's operating income decreased by $22 million compared to $127 million in the second quarter of 2023.
APA Corp anticipates production in 2025 to be slightly higher compared to 2024 based on a combined development capital budget of $2.2 billion to $2.3 billion for the Permian Basin and Egypt.
APA Corp's capital efficiency progress is attributed to the integration of Callon and stabilization of Egypt volumes.
Starbucks’ global comparable store sales declined 4% in the first quarter of fiscal 2025 compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2024.
The decline in U.S. comparable store sales was driven by an 8% decrease in comparable transactions, partially offset by a 4% increase in average ticket.
Visa Inc.'s net revenue increased 10% in FY2025 Q1 compared with the three-month prior-year comparable period.
The net revenue growth was driven by increases in processed transactions, nominal cross-border volume, and nominal payments volume.
Client incentives reduced net revenue by $3,797 million in FY2025 Q1, representing a 13% increase from the prior year.
International transaction revenue grew 14% in FY2025 Q1 to $3,442 million.
The impact of exchange rate movements on net revenue was not material for the three months ended December 31, 2024.
Wynn Resorts, Limited's VIP operations in Macau use a rolling chip method to measure win percentage, where losing wagers are recorded as turnover and winning wagers are paid in cash chips.
Wynn Resorts, Limited's VIP win percentage in Macau is expected to be within the range of 3.1% to 3.4% of turnover.
Solventum Corporation recognized $88 million in expense related to transition agreements with 3M and its affiliates for the three months ended June 30, 2024.
Zebra Technologies Corporation issued $500 million of senior unsecured notes on May 28, 2024, with a 6.5% fixed interest rate.
The net proceeds from the Senior Notes issuance were approximately $492 million after deducting debt issuance costs.
The Senior Notes were used to repay outstanding debt under the Revolving Credit Facility and the Receivables Financing Facility.

LyondellBasell Industries N.V. secured power purchase agreements with an aggregate generation capacity to enable procurement of at least 50 percent of electricity from renewable sources by 2030, based on 2020 levels.
The Wesseling site in Germany implemented process heat recovery projects, electrification of a large process turbine, and steam demand optimization including coal phase-out in 2024.

Ceasing operations at the Houston refinery in Q1 2025 is expected to reduce scope 1 and scope 2 GHG emissions by more than 3 million metric tons annually and scope 3 emissions by approximately 40 million metric tons annually.

M&T Bank Corporation's average core deposits remained flat in FY2024 compared to FY2023, reflecting a stable customer deposit base amidst an elevated interest rate environment and a shift in customer deposits from noninterest-bearing accounts to interest-bearing products, including time deposits.

M&T Bank Corporation's average brokered savings and interest-checking accounts increased to $8.7 billion in FY2024 from $4.6 billion in FY2023, with average rates paid of 4.59% and 4.20%, respectively.
M&T Bank Corporation's average brokered time deposits decreased to $3.2 billion in FY2024 from $6.8 billion in FY2023, with average rates paid of 4.96% and 4.95%, respectively.
PACCAR Inc's adjusted net income (non-GAAP), excluding a $446.4 million after-tax non-recurring charge, was $3.63 billion in 2023.
PACCAR Inc's capital investments were $567.7 million in 2024 compared to $486.5 million in 2023.
PACCAR Inc's R&D expenses were $337.6 million in 2024 compared to $302.0 million in 2023.
PACCAR Inc opened a new 240,000 square-foot Parts Distribution Center in Massbach, Germany in 2024.
PACCAR Financial Services (PFS) group has operations in 26 countries across four continents.
PFS issued $3.25 billion in medium-term notes during the first nine months of 2024.
Palantir Technologies Inc.'s net earnings attributable to common stockholders for diluted net earnings per share was $462,190 in FY2024.
Palantir Technologies Inc.'s diluted net earnings per share attributable to common stockholders was $0.19 in FY2024.
Mohawk Industries' panels mix benefited from growth in premium collections and higher-value decorative panels despite ongoing pressure on commodity panels business.
Occidental has closed or announced divestitures totaling $970 million in 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s net sales were $2.5 billion in the first quarter of 2025 compared to $2.4 billion in the first quarter of 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s operating earnings were $582 million in the first quarter of 2025 compared to $519 million in the first quarter of 2024.

Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s net earnings attributable to the company was $430 million, or $2.53 per diluted common share, in the first quarter of 2025, compared to a net loss of $39 million, or $(0.23) per diluted common share, in the first quarter of 2024.
REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC. plans to expand enrollment in a REGN5678 monotherapy cohort and explore other REGN5678 combinations.

REGN5678 is a novel formulation designed to deliver a concentrated dose of aflibercept to block VEGF-A and PLGF, inhibiting new blood vessel growth and reducing vascular permeability for treating retinal diseases like wAMD, DME, and DR.
Essex Property Trust, Inc. values vacant apartment homes at estimated market rents to calculate financial occupancy.
Financial occupancy compares contractual rental rates for occupied apartment homes to estimated market rents for vacant apartment homes.
Visa Inc.'s service revenue increased primarily due to 7% and 8% growth in nominal payments volume over the three and nine-month prior-year comparable periods, respectively.
Visa Inc.'s data processing revenue increased primarily due to 10% growth in processed transactions over the three and nine-month prior-year comparable periods.

Visa Inc.'s international transaction revenue increased primarily due to growth in nominal cross-border volumes of 12% and 15% over the three and nine-month prior-year comparable periods, respectively, excluding transactions within Europe, partially offset by lower volatility of a broad range of currencies.
Visa Inc.'s other revenue increased primarily due to growth in consulting and marketing services and select pricing modifications over the three and nine-month prior-year comparable periods.
Visa Inc.'s client incentives increased primarily due to growth in payments volume over the three and nine-month prior-year comparable periods.
Teradyne, Inc.'s Semiconductor Test segment benefited from year-over-year growth in the first quarter of 2025, driven by mobility.
Teradyne, Inc. acquired Infineon Technologies AG's automated test equipment technology and associated development team (AET) for $18.3 million in January 2025.
The acquisition of AET is included in Teradyne, Inc.'s Semiconductor Test segment.
Lockheed Martin Corporation recognized a reach-forward loss of approximately $100 million in the first quarter of 2024 for an option exercise.
Lockheed Martin Corporation recognized additional reach-forward losses of approximately $1.31 billion in the fourth quarter of 2024 due to probable option exercises.
Lockheed Martin Corporation's MFC program had cumulative losses of approximately $1.46 billion as of December 31, 2024, including $1.36 billion accrued in other current liabilities.
NextEra Energy, Inc. includes AFUDC of approximately $70 million for the remainder of 2024 through 2028, as stated in the filing passage.
NextEra Energy, Inc. includes AFUDC of approximately $60 million for the remainder of 2024 through 2028, as stated in the filing passage.
NextEra Energy, Inc. includes AFUDC of approximately $20 million for the remainder of 2024 through 2028, as stated in the filing passage.
Delta Air Lines, Inc.'s international passenger revenue increased 7% in the March 2025 quarter compared to the March 2024 quarter.
Gilead Sciences, Inc. faces reimbursement pressures for its existing products, including required rebates and discounts, from government agencies and other third parties.
Gilead Sciences, Inc. relies on third-party vendors such as apheresis centers, shippers, couriers, and hospitals for the logistical collection and delivery of Yescarta and Tecartus.
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. experienced content delivery delays in the first quarter of 2024 due to the pause in television productions in 2023.
The Company does not expect any material impacts from the 2023 production pause for the remainder of 2024.

PPG Industries, Inc.'s Industrial Coatings segment net sales decreased 8.1% in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1 due to divestiture-related sales (-4%), unfavorable foreign currency translation (-2%), lower selling prices (-1%), and lower sales volumes (-1%).
The decline in Industrial Coatings segment net sales was primarily attributed to the impact of foreign currency translation and the divestiture of the silica products business in 2024.
Skyworks Solutions, Inc. authorized a stock repurchase program of up to $2.0 billion, expiring on February 1, 2025, in compliance with applicable securities laws and other legal requirements.

The stock repurchases under the program were conducted at the fair market value of the common stock as of the applicable purchase date to satisfy tax withholding obligations under equity award agreements.

Labcorp Holdings Inc. has a risk factor related to U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulation of diagnostic products, including increased regulation of laboratory-developed tests (LDTs), which could result in increased costs, fines, or penalties and a material adverse effect on the company's business.
Labcorp's diagnostic products, including point-of-care testing devices, are subject to FDA regulation, which involves oversight of development, testing, manufacturing, and marketing processes.
Microsoft Corporation's Intelligent Cloud segment revenue increased 21% in FY2024 Q3 compared with FY2024 Q2.

The Intelligent Cloud segment's revenue growth was driven by Server products and cloud services revenue increasing $4.8 billion or 24%, with Azure and other cloud services revenue growing 31% due to consumption-based services growth.
